blockers: No PROCUREMENT_SIGNAL (temporary/bridge/rental/on-site generation solicitation, contract or award, or PPA/microgrid/O&M agreement) found. Power is HEC grid + on-site steam turbine generators; the repo's 2026-10-16 screen says off-site power work was complete by Aug 2026 and no open generation package was identified.
Older Thacker Pass technical reports (2021/2022) and permit approval (ROD Jan 2021) signals were not captured, so the earliest signal is Jan 2025 only.
The Jan 2025 TRS text calls itself a pre-feasibility level study; the FEASIBILITY_COMPLETE type is a loose fit.
Full-notice-to-proceed is an owner statement in a March 2025 release, not the Q4 2024 event's own timestamp.
